_comment: Elite Four: Will. Masked, dramatic, world traveler, will not stop talking about it.
0:
*backflip* *spin* *pose*Welcome... to the BIG LEAGUE!
I am WILL.I trained on every continent.
Twice. My passport got a passport.My Psychic-type homies read minds.
I already know what you gon' say.And at last... the Elite Four
begged me to join. I only get BETTER! Losin' ain't an option! It ain't even on the MENU!
1:
I lost... but I saw it comin'.
That's the curse of a psychic.I'ma keep scrappin' till I stand
above EVERY Hustler alive!Now go... and experience the
TRUE terror of the Elite Four.*vanishes dramatically*
